decision_notes: Own assembly website designates its recording provider. ALERJ Cumprase public hearing on implementing doulas/humanized-childbirth laws (onscreen 25 June 2026), and Sport/Leisure committee public hearing on sea sport and social inclusion (onscreen 18 August 2026). Both show speakers in identified assembly hearings; these are not two validated plenaries. First recording's upload timing differs from its onscreen meeting date. Two selected recordings decode and advance in Chromium and WebKit; captured Chromium frames were visually reviewed, with additional WebKit visual review for the new Ceará and Paraíba samples. Muted samples do not certify audible quality, current live or complete room coverage.

Official institutional viewing link only. No independent blanket audiovisual reuse grant was established from the reviewed source navigation. Personal-use permission remains pending; no provider embed, extracted media, rehosting or IPTV export is added.
